facility.name: Htcl/Kidz Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Non_Exact match: 1208 S ROBINSON DR, ROBINSON, TX, 76706

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: There was paint observed peeling from some of the walls of the classrooms.  Three rugs in 3 of the classrooms were observed to have stains.  There was food waste observed  be left out in one classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended: There was sufficient evidence found during the DFPS investigation to show that a child was left unattended on the operation's transportation vehicle for approximately 5 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended (26 TAC §746.5605(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: There was sufficient evidence found during the DFPS investigation to show that the operation did not report a situation placing a child at risk to Child Care Regulation within the required time frame.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee conduct walk-through and visual check of vehicle: There was sufficient evidence found during the DFPS investigation to show that the electronic child safety alarm was disabled without a visual check of the vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee conduct walk-through and visual check of vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(d)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: One infant was observed sleeping in a crib with a blanket and a soft toy.  The items were removed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that prohibited punishment was used when caregivers yelled at children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: There was no documentation of the last fire drill available for review.  The provider will conduct a fire drill during the fire inspection 5/4/26.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The last fire inspection was observed to have been completed in February 2025.  A fire inspection was scheduled during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that the operation was not maintaining a clean environment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: There was a garbage can in one classroom observed uncovered.   There was food garbage observed inside and a lid was placed on the garbage can during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that prohibited punishment was used when staff pulled or grabbed children aggressively.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: The was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that prohibited punishment was used when staff members yelled at children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: There were no activity plans posted in the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: 4 out of the 8 staff files reviewed did not have a high school diploma or education verification in their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: One of the four caregivers who were transporting had current transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There was no water at the operation all morning until around 12:00, noon.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Program Unsafe: Three of the four collateral parents that were contacted stated that when they dropped off their children that morning, they were not informed that the water was off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Program Unsafe (26 TAC §746.307(b)(5))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: Operation did not inform Child Care Regulation that the water had been turned off and that they were still operating with children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: A caregiver admitted to threatening to put a child in the closet if the child did not lay down and close their eyes during nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Infant feeding schedules were not current. Some were dated in May.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Open trash cans in multiple classrooms with young toddlers present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Cabinet with cleaning supplies was accessible to one yr olds. Cleaning supplies were immediatly moved to high shelf.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: At least one person who has transported did not have transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: At least 3 caregivers did not have first aid/CPR. One caregiver completed the CPR online.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: Observed at least 3 caregivers without any annual training. I spoke to the director about the importance of training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Three classrooms were observed to have cleaners at a children's level and was easily accessible to children. Director immediately moved cleaners higher out of reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Two children exited the operation unsupervised and were unsupervised for a few minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During an investigation, it was determined a caregiver did not demonstrate good judgment when she allowed a child, who had been pushed by another child, to hit that child back.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: There were two classrooms out of ratio. Both had a specified age of 3 years and had 17 children with one caregiver.     This was corrected when more caregivers arrived and children were split into smaller groups.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During an investigation, it was determined classrooms are regularly out of ratio for 30 minutes in the morning.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There were several broken toys on the playground. There a broken shelf in a classroom that was being used
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Out of ten staff files reviewed, ten staff did not have 24 hours of required training available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director did not have the required 30 hours of annual training available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: There were two garbage cans with no lids that had used diapers in the garbage can that was accessible to children in care. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver removed the diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Infant feed instructions were not updated for five infants.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: Operation did not have a children's product certification completed within the last year available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Pre-service Training- Developmental Stages: Five caregivers did not have Pre-Service training available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pre-service Training- Developmental Stages (26 TAC §746.1305(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: The food allergy plan does not explain possible symptoms if the child has an allergic reaction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Driver Has Current Driver's License: Two drivers did not have a current driver's license available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Driver Has Current Driver's License (26 TAC §746.5617(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies: Five out of ten employee did not have a signed statement that they received the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's personnel policies: Five out of ten employee did not have a signed statement that they received the personnel policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's personnel policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(B))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: The operation purchased a van to transport children in 2019. The van does not have an electronic child safety alarm. This was corrected at inspection when the operation stated they will not transport children in that van until an alarm is installed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director did not have current transportation training available for review at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Three out of ten caregivers did not have CPR and First Aid training available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
